project_type: Firebase web app with Cloud Functions (Electron-style renderer)
language: JavaScript (ES modules frontend, CommonJS Cloud Functions)
build_system: Firebase CLI for deployment, no local build step for renderer
test_framework: No automated test framework found in the project
build_command: No build command - static files served directly
verification_instructions: 1. Check that renderer.js has valid JS syntax (node --check). 2. Verify functions/index.js has valid syntax. 3. Verify index.html cache buster is updated to v=50.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - direct file editing
environment_constraints: No build system. Firebase deploy happens from user's local PC. We just push code to main.
key_patterns: Single-file renderer.js (~3861 lines) with all UI logic. Styles injected via JS <style> elements. DOM created programmatically. Uses estado global object, $() for querySelector, esc() for escaping. Voice assistant uses Web Speech API with SpeechRecognition. Cloud Function at functions/index.js uses Vertex AI Gemini. CSS variables defined in styles.css.
directory_structure: Root: firebase.json, functions/ (Cloud Functions), src/renderer/ (frontend: index.html, renderer.js, styles.css, auth.js, db.js)
